SELECT
productGroupName AS itemName, SUM(qty) AS qty, SUM(totalPrice) AS totalPrice
productGroupName AS parentName, productName AS itemName, productCode AS code, qty, uomName, AVG(unitPrice) AS unitPrice, SUM(totalPrice) AS totalPrice
type, `date` AS date, invoiceCode, itemName, qty, organizationName, warehouseName, uomName, unitPrice, totalPrice
FROM ( SELECT IF(sales_orders.is_pos = 1, 'POS', 'Invoice') AS type, COALESCE(pgroups.name, 'No Group') AS productGroupName, CONCAT_WS(' ', products.code, products.name) AS itemName, products.name AS productName, products.code AS productCode, sales_orders.order_date AS `date`, sales_orders.so_code AS invoiceCode, CONCAT_WS(' ', customers.customer_code, customers.name) AS organizationName, location_groups.name AS warehouseName,
(sales_order_details.qty + sales_order_details.qty_free) AS qty
sales_order_details.qty AS qty
, sales_order_details.conversion, uoms.name AS uomName, sales_order_details.unit_price AS unitPrice, sales_order_details.total_price AS totalPrice FROM sales_orders INNER JOIN sales_order_details ON sales_orders.id = sales_order_details.sales_order_id INNER JOIN products ON sales_order_details.product_id = products.id LEFT JOIN product_pgroups ON sales_order_details.product_id = product_pgroups.product_id LEFT JOIN pgroups ON product_pgroups.pgroup_id = pgroups.id AND pgroups.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN customers ON sales_orders.customer_id = customers.id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON sales_orders.location_group_id = location_groups.id LEFT JOIN uoms ON sales_order_details.qty_uom_id = uoms.id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Credit Memo' AS type, COALESCE(pgroups.name, 'No Group') AS productGroupName, CONCAT_WS(' ', products.code, products.name) AS itemName, products.name AS productName, products.code AS productCode, credit_memos.order_date AS `date`, credit_memos.cm_code AS invoiceCode, CONCAT_WS(' ', customers.customer_code, customers.name) AS organizationName, location_groups.name AS warehouseName,
((credit_memo_details.qty + credit_memo_details.qty_free) * -1) AS qty
(credit_memo_details.qty * -1) AS qty
, credit_memo_details.conversion, uoms.name AS uomName, credit_memo_details.unit_price AS unitPrice, (credit_memo_details.total_price * -1) AS totalPrice FROM credit_memos INNER JOIN credit_memo_details ON credit_memos.id = credit_memo_details.credit_memo_id INNER JOIN products ON credit_memo_details.product_id = products.id LEFT JOIN product_pgroups ON credit_memo_details.product_id = product_pgroups.product_id LEFT JOIN pgroups ON product_pgroups.pgroup_id = pgroups.id AND pgroups.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN customers ON credit_memos.customer_id = customers.id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON credit_memos.location_group_id = location_groups.id LEFT JOIN uoms ON credit_memo_details.qty_uom_id = uoms.id
) AS result
GROUP BY productGroupName
GROUP BY productName, productCode
ORDER BY itemName, `date` ASC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
